name: multi-judge-demo
description: Demonstrates multiple LLM judge blocks with severity and per-judge model
abortOnFailure: false

## Test
Create a TypeScript function that fetches a URL and returns the response body as a string. Include error handling for network failures and HTTP errors. Save it to /tmp/fetcher.ts.

## Checkpoint

### Checks
contains: fetch
script: test -f /tmp/fetcher.ts && echo "file exists"

### Judge
The function must handle both network errors (e.g. DNS failure) and HTTP errors (e.g. 404, 500) separately, not with a single catch-all.

### Judge (opus)
Evaluate the TypeScript code quality: proper typing (no `any`), async/await usage, and whether the error handling covers edge cases.

### warn-Judge (haiku)
Does the code include JSDoc or inline comments explaining the error handling strategy?
